items.stem: 다음 글의 제목으로 가장 적절한 것은?

sentences.text: Imagine a group of shoppers who trust a drink more after seeing the word "natural" on its label.
They treat the word as if it guaranteed that the drink were healthier or safer.
The word alone, however, does not describe which ingredients are inside the drink.
The imagined drink could still contain a long list of sweeteners and additives.
The word, in short, tells buyers far less than they believe it does.
Reading the list of ingredients is a much more reliable way to judge what is inside the package.

choices.text: Why Shoppers Should Avoid Natural Foods
The Empty Promise of the "Natural" Label
How Additives Make Drinks Sweeter
Reading Ingredients: The Key to Healthy Eating
Natural or Artificial: Which Food Is Safer?

items.stem: 다음 글의 요지로 가장 적절한 것은?

sentences.text: A packing team uses records for two different jobs.
A worker taking over a shift needs a short note about which orders still need attention.
An analyst comparing recurring delays needs details from many earlier shifts.
One compact handoff note cannot supply that long history, while a complete archive can hide the few tasks that need action now.
The team therefore keeps both a handoff note and a detailed log instead of requiring one report to serve every job.

choices.text: 팀의 모든 기록은 현재 과제만 짧게 요약해야 한다.
작업을 시작하기 전에 모든 과거 교대 기록을 읽어야 한다.
작업자와 분석가는 반드시 같은 전문 기술을 갖추어야 한다.
이 팀의 기록은 각 작업에 필요한 정보에 맞추어 구성해야 한다.
교대 메모만 있으면 장기적인 지연의 원인을 모두 알 수 있다.

items.stem: 다음 글의 요지로 가장 적절한 것은?

sentences.text: In this imaginary repair club, a fault log is valuable when it helps volunteers improve their work rather than assign blame.
The log records which tools people could not find and which instructions they misunderstood.
If shelves are moved and instructions rewritten in response, the same difficulties may be avoided next time.
If entries are used only to rank volunteers, people may stop describing confusing moments.
The same page of notes can therefore guide better work or discourage useful reporting, depending on how the club uses it.

choices.text: 작업자의 잘못이 드러나지 않도록 오류 기록을 없애야 한다.
수리 동아리에서 가장 중요한 기록은 도구의 목록이다.
이 동아리의 오류 기록은 사람을 탓하기보다 작업을 개선하는 데 쓸 때 가치가 있다.
작업을 개선하려면 자원봉사자의 순위를 공개해야 한다.
모든 작업실에 동일한 지침을 적용하면 효율이 높아진다.

items.stem: 다음 글의 요지로 가장 적절한 것은?

sentences.text: Imagine a reading club that renovates a room but leaves its booking hours unclear.
For this club, making access clear matters alongside improving the room itself.
Some members arrive while the room is locked and leave without trying the new seats.
Replacing those seats again would not tell these members when they can enter.
A timetable beside the booking form would address that different difficulty.

choices.text: 이 동아리는 방을 개선하는 것과 함께 이용 시간도 명확히 알려야 한다.
좋은 의자가 있으면 동아리 회원들이 반드시 더 자주 방문한다.
동아리 회원들은 이용 시간에 맞추어 모임을 줄여야 한다.
시간표가 있으면 실내 시설을 개선할 필요가 전혀 없다.
모임 기록을 공유하는 것이 좌석을 교체하는 것보다 저렴하다.

raw_response.claim_paraphrase: The word “natural” provides less information about a product than shoppers assume.
raw_response.evidence_reasoning: Shoppers infer health and safety from the label, although it does not identify ingredients. Sentence 4 illustrates this limitation with a drink that could contain many additives. Checking ingredients offers a more reliable alternative.

raw_response.claim_paraphrase: The team needs separate records suited to immediate handoffs and long-term analysis.
raw_response.evidence_reasoning: Workers need pending tasks, while analysts need historical detail. Sentence 4 explains why one report cannot serve both purposes effectively, supporting the decision to maintain two records.

raw_response.claim_paraphrase: The club’s fault log is valuable when used to improve work instead of blaming volunteers.
raw_response.evidence_reasoning: Sentence 3 illustrates constructive use: changing shelves and instructions can prevent repeated problems. Ranking volunteers can instead discourage reporting. These contrasting outcomes show that the log’s value depends on its use.

raw_response.claim_paraphrase: The club should clarify access hours alongside improving the room.
raw_response.evidence_reasoning: Members cannot enjoy better seats when they arrive at a locked room. Sentence 4 explains why replacing seats again cannot solve unclear access hours. A timetable addresses that separate problem.

raw_response.claim_paraphrase: 'natural'이라는 단어는 소비자가 믿는 것보다 훨씬 적은 정보만 준다.
raw_response.evidence_reasoning: 3번이 단어가 성분을 설명하지 않는다는 이유를, 4번이 감미료·첨가물이 들어 있을 수 있다는 가상 예시를 들어 5번 결론을 뒷받침한다. 1·5번은 글에 없는 주장이고, 4번은 6번의 대안만 제목으로 키웠다.

raw_response.claim_paraphrase: 작업마다 필요한 정보가 다르므로 기록을 용도별로 나눠 둔다.
raw_response.evidence_reasoning: 2·3번이 두 작업의 서로 다른 필요를 제시하고, 4번이 한 보고서로는 두 필요를 모두 채울 수 없다는 이유를 들어 5번 '따라서 둘 다 유지'로 이어진다. 1·2·5번은 한쪽 기록만 강조한다.

raw_response.claim_paraphrase: 오류 기록은 사람을 탓하기보다 작업 개선에 쓰일 때 가치가 있다.
raw_response.evidence_reasoning: 3번은 기록을 반영해 선반과 지침을 고치면 같은 어려움을 피한다는 개선 사례다. 4번은 순위 매기기에 쓰면 보고가 사라진다는 대조 사례이고, 5번이 쓰임새에 따라 결과가 갈린다고 1번을 재진술한다.

raw_response.claim_paraphrase: 방을 개선하는 것과 함께 이용 시간을 분명히 알리는 것도 중요하다.
raw_response.evidence_reasoning: 3번은 문이 잠겨 새 의자를 써 보지도 못한 회원들의 문제를 보여 준다. 4번은 의자를 다시 바꿔도 입장 시간 문제는 풀리지 않는다는 이유이고, 5번이 시간표라는 해결책을 제시한다. 4번 선택지는 시설 개선이 불필요하다고 과장했다.

Training source:
1. Show one painting to two groups, give each group a different title for it, and they will describe two different scenes.
2. One group notices the sky; the other notices the small figure in the corner.
3. This happens because a title tells the eye where to begin.
4. A viewer facing a new image has no order to follow, so the first words attached to it become a kind of route through the frame.
5. Once that route is set, the details along it feel important and the rest fades into background.
6. The same is true of a song or a story, since a name at the top decides what counts as the subject.
7. For this reason a title is not a label stuck on after the work is done.
8. It belongs to the work, and choosing it is a real decision.
9. Some artists refuse to name a piece at all, and that refusal is a choice too, because it hands the route back to the viewer.

1. Show one painting to two groups, give each group a different title for it, and they will describe two different scenes.
2. One group notices the sky; the other notices the small figure in the corner.
3. This happens because a title tells the eye where to begin.
4. A viewer facing a new image has no order to follow, so the first words attached to it become a kind of route through the frame.
5. Once that route is set, the details along it feel important and the rest fades into background.
6. The same is true of a song or a story, since a name at the top decides what counts as the subject.
7. For this reason a title is not a label stuck on after the work is done.
8. It belongs to the work, and choosing it is a real decision.
9. Some artists refuse to name a piece at all, and that refusal is a choice too, because it hands the route back to the viewer.
